The image here ([[:File:VB4-D-junoeclipseblackleaderai-pre.gif]]) prints this text; [[:File:VL-history-1240-3-front-original.png]] shows the original text (see [[Black Leader (V) (AI)]]). The regular printing is [[Black Leader (V)]] / [[Juno Eclipse, Black Leader (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Black Leader (V) (AI)]]): printed as “•Black Leader”, lore “A shining example of Imperial honor and bravery. Female.”, text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 02AI, printed as “Black Leader (V) AI”)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. Deploys -1 to starships. Naboo Blaster is a matching weapon for Black Leader. While with Galen at a site, adds one battle destiny. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to retrieve a card with “back” in title. Immune to attrition < 3.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same title (“Black Leader (AI)”) and text, with “'back'” in single quotes.<ref name="cl-1240_3-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The game text above writes the pilot icon “3” out as “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots”.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) retitled the card “•Juno Eclipse, Black Leader (AI)”, removed the lore and changed “for Black Leader” to “for her”: “[Pilot] 3. Deploys -1 to starships. Naboo Blaster is a matching weapon for her. While with Galen at a site, adds one battle destiny. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to retrieve a card with “back” in title. Immune to attrition < 3.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[Black Leader (V) (AI)]].
